name: Orangey Red
lede: Orangey Red is a vivid, hot red named by plain grammar: the modifier "orangey" pushing the base color [[red]] toward orange.

sections.title: A modifier on an existing color
sections.body:
*Orangey* softens [[orange]] into a qualifier, the same pattern seen in [[orangey-brown|Orangey Brown]]; paired with *red*, it marks this as a red pulled toward orange rather than a coined name [1]. The exact value comes from the 2010 xkcd online color-name survey, and our sources record no earlier use of the two-word phrase as a fixed color name, only as ordinary descriptive English [1].

The nearest named look-alikes on file are [[scarlet|Scarlet]] and [[bright-red|Bright Red]], both more vivid [2].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: A close match to this red appears in only 6 of our 23,781 archived paintings, about 0.03 per cent, with the within-painting lens also finding it in 6; rarer than 73 per cent of our named colors [3]. The sample is too small here to support any claim about when or where it is most common; these are photographs of aged, varnished paintings, not a pigment test [3].
